r.name: Wales Coast Path (North Wales) main route
EuroVelo 2 - Capitals Route - part United Kingdom 1
r.name:fr: EuroVelo 2 - La route des capitales - part Royaume-Uni 1

r.name: Craflwyn, Hafod y Llan and Llyn Dinas walk, Craflwyn
r.description: This route starts & ends at Craflwyn, but allows you to explore the Nant Gwynant valley. Take in the wild & lonely heath & ffridd beneath Yr Aran, the lower slope of Wales' highest peak, Yr Wyddfa (Snowdon), waterfalls of Afon Cwm Llan & Llyn Dinas lake.

r.name: Gelert's Grave Walk, Meirionydd
r.description: This circular riverside walk will give an insight into the legend of Gelert & Prince Llywelyn which gave the village its name, & why Beddgelert became popular with travel writers like T Pennant & artists like JMW Turner. Suitable for wheel & pushchairs.

r.name: The Legendary Trail of Dinas Emrys, Craflwyn
r.description: Enjoy a pleasant walk past waterfalls & through oak woodland to the legendary summit, where Merlin once trod & a dragon still sleeps. At the top you’ll find remains of a square tower & defensive ramparts belonging to the ancient princes of Gwynedd.

r.name: Hidden Corners of Plas Newydd, Plas Newydd
r.description: Enjoy stunning views over the Menai Strait, the Faenol and Snowdonia as you walk around the beautiful grounds of Plas Newydd.

r.name: Glan Faenol Wildlife and Woodland Walk, Glan Faenol
r.description: A moderate walk where you'll explore varied native woodland and ancient parkland. Enjoy views of the house and gardens at Plas Newydd and the hills of Snowdonia. If you're lucky, you might even catch a glimpse of a seal in the Menai Strait.

r.name: Llyn Ogwen Circular Walk, Carneddau
r.description: Experience great views of Tryfan and the Glyderau mountains from this lakeshore trail without committing to a strenuous hike up to the summits of Eryri (Snowdonia).

r.name: Cwm Idwal Walk, Carneddau
r.description: A moderately strenuous walk with dramatic mountainous scenery at the oldest NNR in Wales. Explore beautiful ice-sculpted Cwm Idwal – a bowl-shaped hollow filled with the clear waters of Llyn Idwal, famous for its rock formations & rare/fragile plant life.

r.name: Aberglaslyn, Bryn Du and Beddgelert walk, Meirionydd
r.description: This circular walking trail takes you through ancient woodland and across magnificent mountain scenery of Eryri (Snowdonia) as well as visiting Gelert's grave at Beddgelert and to the spectacular Aberglaslyn gorge.

r.name: Aberglaslyn, Llyn Dinas and Cwm Bychan walk, Eifionydd
r.description: Take in Aberglaslyn gorge with the Glaslyn river raging alongside the narrow path. Pass Bedd y Ci (the grave of Prince Llywelyn's faithful hound), Beddgelert village, the placid waters of Llyn Dinas & the old copper mine workings of Sygun and Cwm Bychan.

r.name: Discover Nature Walk at Penrhyn Castle, Penrhyn
r.description: Enjoy a circular walk around the lesser-known parts of the castle grounds. Take in the natural space and discover a diverse range of wildlife and nature that call this place home. Grass and gravel paths, some slight inclines, uneven surfaces and steps.
